data.label: AlexNet wins ImageNet
data.detail: CNN achieves 15.3% error rate, 10.8pp better than runner-up. Ignites deep learning revolution.

data.label: GANs published
data.detail: Goodfellow et al. introduce Generative Adversarial Networks.

data.label: Seq2Seq + Attention
data.detail: Bahdanau attention mechanism enables neural machine translation breakthroughs.

data.label: ResNet (152 layers)
data.detail: Residual connections enable training very deep networks. Superhuman on ImageNet.

data.label: AlphaGo defeats Lee Sedol
data.detail: DeepMind's Go AI wins 4-1 against world champion. Global media event.

data.label: Transformer architecture
data.detail: 'Attention Is All You Need' — foundation of all modern LLMs.

data.label: GPT-1 (117M params)
data.detail: OpenAI demonstrates unsupervised pre-training + fine-tuning paradigm.

data.label: BERT
data.detail: Bidirectional pre-training dominates NLP benchmarks. Google deploys in Search.

data.label: GPT-3 (175B params)
data.detail: Few-shot learning without fine-tuning. Demonstrates emergence of capabilities at scale.

data.label: DALL-E & CLIP
data.detail: Text-to-image generation and vision-language understanding.

data.label: PaLM (540B params)
data.detail: Google's large model shows chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities.

data.label: GPT-4
data.detail: Multimodal LLM passes bar exam (90th percentile), SAT (99th percentile).

data.label: Gemini 1.5 (1M context)
data.detail: Million-token context window enables new application paradigms.

data.label: o1 reasoning model
data.detail: Chain-of-thought at inference time. PhD-level reasoning on benchmarks.

data.label: Claude 3.5 / GPT-4.5
data.detail: Frontier models achieve near-human performance on most professional tasks.

data.label: Siri launches
data.detail: Apple ships first mainstream voice assistant on iPhone 4S.

data.label: Amazon Echo / Alexa
data.detail: Voice AI enters the home. 100M+ units sold by 2020.

data.label: Google Translate goes neural
data.detail: NMT replaces phrase-based MT. Translation quality jumps dramatically.

data.label: Google Duplex demo
data.detail: AI makes phone calls to book appointments. Raises ethical questions.

data.label: GPT-3 API launches
data.detail: First commercial large language model API. Spawns thousands of AI startups.

data.label: GitHub Copilot preview
data.detail: AI pair programming goes mainstream. 1M+ developers by 2022.

data.label: Stable Diffusion open-sourced
data.detail: Text-to-image AI becomes freely available. Disrupts creative industries.

data.label: ChatGPT launches
data.detail: 100M users in 2 months — fastest consumer app adoption in history.

data.label: Microsoft Bing + GPT-4
data.detail: AI integrated into search. Triggers Google's 'code red' and Bard launch.

data.label: Meta releases Llama 2
data.detail: Open-source LLM competitive with proprietary models. Democratizes access.

data.label: AI agents in enterprise
data.detail: Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP ship AI agent products. Enterprise adoption accelerates.

data.label: OpenAI GPT-4o
data.detail: Real-time multimodal interaction. Voice, vision, text unified.

data.label: AI coding agents mainstream
data.detail: Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot Workspace — AI writes majority of new code at top companies.

regulation_milestones.description: Key AI regulation and policy events (2010-2025)

data.label: Obama White House AI report
data.detail: First major US government report on AI policy implications.

data.label: EU GDPR takes effect
data.detail: Not AI-specific but includes 'right to explanation' for automated decisions.

data.label: EU AI Ethics Guidelines
data.detail: High-Level Expert Group publishes 'Trustworthy AI' framework. Non-binding.

data.label: EU AI White Paper
data.detail: European Commission proposes risk-based regulatory framework for AI.

data.label: EU AI Act proposed
data.detail: First comprehensive AI regulation. Risk-based tiers: unacceptable/high/limited/minimal.

data.label: US AI Bill of Rights
data.detail: White House blueprint for AI rights. Non-binding framework.

data.label: EU AI Act agreed
data.detail: European Parliament approves AI Act with last-minute generative AI provisions.

data.label: White House voluntary commitments
data.detail: 7 leading AI companies (OpenAI, Google, Meta, etc.) sign safety commitments.

data.label: Biden Executive Order on AI
data.detail: Most significant US AI policy action. Safety testing, watermarking, federal use standards.

data.label: Bletchley Declaration
data.detail: 28 countries + EU sign declaration on AI safety at UK AI Safety Summit.

data.label: EU AI Act enacted
data.detail: World's first comprehensive AI law. Compliance deadlines begin 2025-2027.

data.label: California SB 1047 signed
data.detail: First major US state-level AI safety legislation.

data.label: EU AI Act enforcement begins
data.detail: First tier of EU AI Act obligations take effect. Banned practices enforced.

ai_investment.description: Global private AI investment by year (billions USD)
